project_type: Django 5.2.17 web application with template inheritance, PostgreSQL backend, no JavaScript framework dependencies
build_system: Django built-in development server, pip for dependencies, no build tools required
test_framework: Django TestCase (python manage.py test), manual browser testing for UI verification
verification_instructions: 1. Run python manage.py check → 0 issues. 2. Run python manage.py runserver and manually verify all 16 templates render correctly. 3. Check responsive design at mobile (375px), tablet (768px), desktop (1440px) widths. 4. Verify WCAG contrast ratios and keyboard navigation.
environment_constraints: Windows PowerShell environment. Django development server runs on port 8000. Virtual environment at .venv/. Static files served via Django staticfiles during development. No collectstatic needed for dev testing.
contribution_requirements: AGENTS.md requires: strict type safety where applicable, defensive error handling, security-first approach (OWASP Top 10), NO placeholders or 'implement later' comments, complete code only, follow SOLID principles and DRY, preserve all existing functionality including authentication/authorization/RBAC, maintain Django template structure and inheritance, preserve form validations and CSRF protection.
key_patterns: Template inheritance: base.html → role-specific pages. CSS design tokens in :root variables (--c-primary, --c-accent, --c-bg, --c-sidebar, etc.). Role-based theming via data-role attributes. Lucide icons via CDN. Google Fonts (Inter, Poppins). Current design is feature-rich with gradients, shadows, glassmorphism, animations, and complex color schemes. Student pages use dark oceanic theme with gradients and animated orbs.
directory_structure: templates/ contains base.html and subdirectories: public/, registration/, student/, counselor/, receptionist/, admin/, widgets/, partials/. static/ contains css/app.css and js/ files. core/ app contains views/, services/, models.py, guards.py. config/ contains settings.py and urls.py.
